business_scope.primary_industry_name: Fiduciary Administration of Irrevocable Offshore Spendthrift Trusts

stage_1.document_name: Certified copy of passport (full colour, notarized) of each proposed shareholder/UBO-director
stage_1.issuing_entity: Passport authority of the country of nationality (notarization by local notary acceptable)
stage_1.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for countries party to the 1961 Convention; Consular Legalization via the Spanish Consulate for non-Contracting States

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2010 (Ley de Sociedades de Capital), Arts. 1-33, 54-58, 111-129; Regulation of the Commercial Registry (Reglamento del Registro Mercantil), Arts. 175-200
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Mercantil Central and Provincial Commercial Registry of the registered office; notarized deed submitted via the corresponding Colegio de Registradores portal
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución (Public Deed of Incorporation) followed by Inscripción in the Registro Mercantil
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Minimum share capital EUR 3,000, fully subscribed and paid in cash or in kind at incorporation; bank certificate (certificado de desembolso) or notarial attestation of deposit required; no separate escrow account for general SL formation, but for fiduciary activity a separate regulated trust reserve may apply
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The shareholders unanimously resolve to: (1) accept the subscribed share capital of EUR 3,000 fully paid in cash; (2) adopt the draft bylaws as executed in the Public Deed of Incorporation; (3) establish the registered office at the address stated in the deed and authorize the opening of the corporate bank account; (4) elect the Sole Administrator or joint Board of Directors as named; (5) approve the initiation of the application for the requisite fiduciary and operational licenses; and (6) direct the Secretary to file all necessary registrations with the Commercial Registry and tax authorities. This resolution becomes effective immediately upon signing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-incorporation Name Reservation and Negative Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Central (Central Commercial Registry), online via the Ministry of Justice portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File an online request for a negative name certificate (certificación negativa de denominación) confirming the proposed SL name is not identical or confusingly similar to existing Spanish companies. The request must include primary and two alternative names. The certificate is valid for three months and must be presented to the notary within its validity period.
required_dossiers: Application form for negative name certificate
DNI/NIE of each founder (or passport with apostille if non-resident)
Proposed corporate names (primary and two alternates)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, the registry issues an official note listing conflicting names; within one week resubmit with an alternative name that avoids the noted conflict, paying a reduced processing fee only for the new search.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of Public Deed of Incorporation before a Spanish Notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary of the domicile province (Notario de Madrid or the province of the registered office)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Founders appear before the notary to execute the Escritura de Constitución, incorporating the approved name certificate, the full text of the bylaws (estatutos), proof of capital deposit (bank certificate or block deposit certificate), and the valuation report for any in-kind contributions. The notary verifies the legal capacity of all founders, levies the corresponding notarial fee, and issues the original deed for registration.
required_dossiers: Negative name certificate (valid original)
Proposed bylaws (estatutos sociales) signed by all founders
Bank certificate of capital deposit (certificado de desembolso) or in-kind valuation report
Identity documents of all founders and any appointed directors
Proof of payment of notarial fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary detects a defect in the deed (e.g., missing capital deposit certificate), the parties amend the additional statement (comparecencia) and re-execute the deed the same day; only the amended deed is presented for registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registry Inscription (Inscripción en el Registro Mercantil Provincial)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Commercial Registry of the province of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the notarized deed (first copy) together with the approved negative name certificate and a copy of the tax on capital transactions form (modelo 600) to the Provincial Commercial Registry for legal inscription. The registry reviews compliance with the Companies Act and registers the company; registration confers legal personality.
required_dossiers: First copy of the Public Deed of Incorporation, notarized
Negative name certificate
Modelo 600 (Transfer of Assets and Documented Legal Acts) filing proof
Statement of no prior registration conflicts
Directors' acceptance of appointments
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a calificación suspensiva (suspension), the irregularities described in the negative note must be cured within two months; the notary issues a corrective deed or the founders amend the bylaws, then resubmit with the registry's original annotation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Tax Identification Number (CIF/NIF) and Initial Tax Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT), local tax office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After inscription, the SL must apply for a definitive NIF (tax identification number) within one month of the deed date, completing modelo 036 (census registration). The application must include the registry certification of incorporation. Execute provincial or national census declarations and, if the SL will be subject to VAT, complete modelo 036 with the relevant business activity codes (IAE 6430).
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the Commercial Registry inscription
Form model 036 duly completed
Power of attorney of the legal representative
Identity documents of directors
Bank account details for the SL
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the AEAT requires additional information, correct the defect via the electronic office (sede electrónica) by amending model 036 or submitting supplementary evidence; the NIF is provisionally assigned within 24 hours after the correction, with the definitive NIF following final review.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: AML and Fiduciary Registration (Special License for Trust Administration Activities)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Servicio Ejecutivo de la Comisión de Prevención del Blanqueo de Capitales e Infracciones Monetarias (SEPBLAC) within Banco de España / Ministerial Commission
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: As the SL will administer irrevocable offshore spendthrift trusts, it must register as an obliged entity under the Spanish AML Law (Ley 10/2010) and obtain a specific fiduciary activity authorization. Submit an incorporation compliance dossier detailing the AML internal control manual, the designated compliance officer, a customer due diligence policy, and a transaction monitoring plan for all Swift-wire and fiduciary account operations. The application is submitted online via SEPBLAC's telematics portal, accompanied by the constitutional and tax documents.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Commercial Registry inscription
Definitive NIF certificate
AML internal control manual (procedures and risk assessment)
Organizational chart and compliance officer appointment deed
Customer due diligence policy and transaction monitoring plan
Declaration of business model (trust administration / asset protection trust)
Proof of solvency and professional liability insurance
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: In case of a query from SEPBLAC, provide supplementary AML risk assessments and beneficial ownership identification within the granted 15-day period; any deficiency in the internal control manual must be amended and the corrected version re-submitted. If the license is denied, the SL may appeal through the administrative route before the Ministry of Economy and Digital Transformation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Industrial and Physical Premises Clearance (Fire Safety, Structural Inspection, and Municipal Operating Permit)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Municipal Town Hall (Ayuntamiento) and the Industrial Licensing Department of the Autonomous Community
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Secure municipal activity license (licencia de apertura) for offices or data-handling centers where the trust administration operates. Submit a responsible declaration of compliance (declaración responsable) covering fire safety, disabled-access, electric installation, and environmental health compliances, along with a desinsectación and waste treatment plan if applicable. If the SL administers trust assets that include heavy physical property, an industrial establishment authorization may be required from the regional industry authority.
required_dossiers: Operating lease or ownership title of the registered office
Technical conformity report (fire safety, electrical installation, structural load) issued by a certified technical professional
Municipal licensing application (avance/permiso) or responsible declaration
Insurance certificates (fire, occupational risk, civil liability)
Proof of civil defense voluntary inspection fee payment
Wastes and hazardous material declaration (if any)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipal inspector detects physical or safety non-compliance, remedy within the remediation period (typically 15 days) by conducting the necessary structural works, obtaining a new technical report, and reverifying the corrected items; otherwise the license is suspended until full compliance.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Industria, Comercio y Turismo (General Directorate of Industrial Policy) and the corresponding regional Industry and Energy Department
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Autorización de Entidad de Administración Fiduciaria y de Activos / Licencia de Apertura de Establecimiento Fiduciario

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico (MITERD) / Autonomous Community Environmental Authority
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category C (Registration) – only a simplified environmental registration and necessary discharge authorizations; full EIA is not required for an office-only fiduciary administration facility unless the trust manages physical industrial assets, in which case the trust's underlying asset may require its own EIA classification
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Directive 2010/75/EU (Industrial Emissions Directive) and Real Decreto 815/2013: VOCs below 100 mg C/Nm³ for solvent-containing operations; pH 6-9 for wastewater discharged to municipal collector, BOD5 below 500 mg/L, COD below 900 mg/L; hazardous waste must be managed by registered gestor and recorded in the RAUCEL system

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Mandatory fire safety certification under the building technical code (CTE DB-SI), a valid fire extinguishing system inspection, structural load certificate for any archive or vault storing trust assets, and an occupational health and safety clearance (Real Decreto 486/1997) including periodic workplace inspections and emergency evacuation drills

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Spanish SL entities obtain NIF (CIF/NIF) upon incorporation through the Mercantile Registry. Foreign entities register for tax identification if establishing a permanent establishment or conducting business in Spain by submitting incorporation documents and tax residency proofs to the Agencia Tributaria.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box elections available. Tax classification determined by legal form and substance; hybrid mismatch rules under Spanish Law 27/2014 and EU directives may apply.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time electronic invoicing via SII (Immediate Information System) for qualifying taxpayers; digital invoice stamping and API integration with Agencia Tributaria for clearance.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods exported outside the EU require proof of export (customs declaration, transport documents). Offshore services to non-EU recipients qualify for 0% VAT if invoiced and paid from abroad with appropriate substantiation.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration, Bill of Lading, Inward Remittance Certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent zero-rating claims result in penalties of up to 100% of the claimed amount plus interest, and potential criminal liability for tax evasion.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de España (Bank of Spain), acting jointly with the Dirección General de Comercio Internacional e Inversiones (Secretaría de Estado de Comercio, Ministerio de Industria, Comercio y Turismo), as the competent authority for foreign transaction registration, balance-of-payments reporting, and enforcement of Spanish AML/CFT obligations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Spain maintains full current and capital account convertibility under the Eurosystem architecture and Article 63 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union. There are no general exchange controls, prior administrative approval requirements, or restrictions on inward/outward wire transfers denominated in EUR or foreign currency. Dividend, interest, profit-remittance, and trust distribution flows may be effected freely in respect of EU/EEA and non-EU counterparties, subject only to anti-money-laundering screening, tax withholding duties where a Spanish payer is involved, and statistical/balance-of-payments declaration duties. A Spanish resident corporate entity engaging in foreign payment operations above the materiality threshold must complete the corresponding Bank of Spain statistical declaration, but such filing is an ex-post transparency obligation rather than a condition precedent to transfer authorization.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Spain imposes no export proceeds surrender obligation, no mandatory conversion into EUR, and no time limit for holding foreign-currency export receipts. Resident exporters may freely retain export proceeds in domestic or foreign bank accounts and may deploy those proceeds for Treasury purposes without special authorization. The only administrative requirement is the periodic or transaction-specific statistical reporting to Banco de España where the receipt exceeds the applicable balance-of-payments reporting threshold, generally EUR 50,000 per transaction or as amended by Bank of Spain circulars.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Fiduciary Trust Account and Operational Euro Settlement Account
Fiduciary Trust Account and Operational Euro Settlement Account
Fiduciary Trust Account and Operational Euro Settlement Account
Fiduciary Trust Account and Operational Euro Settlement Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium-Low. Payment institutions and electronic-money institutions (EMIs) authorized under the revised Payment Services Directive (PSD2) and registered with the Bank of Spain, or passporting from another EEA state, are operationally viable for pooling, payroll, supplier payments, and FX conversion. However, for a high-risk fiduciary activity involving an irrevocable offshore spendthrift trust, most Spanish banks and regulated EMIs apply heightened AML/CFT risk categorization, and EMIs commonly reject entities requiring a special license or holding client funds. An EMI may be used as a supplementary treasury rail only if it obtains a legal opinion confirming compatibility with Spanish AML Law 10/2010, the SL's scope of business, and the permitted payment services list.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In-person physical presence is generally required for the managing director or an authorized signatory during initial onboarding of a high-risk corporate client, unless the bank has implemented a certified video-identification process approved under Bank of Spain AML circular and the client cannot be classified as medium or high risk. For an SL acting as fiduciary administrator and management company of a discretionary asset protection trust, the practical standard is stricter: at least one Spanish-resident director or a fully empowered attorney-in-fact with notarized and apostilled power of attorney must attend a face-to-face interview at the bank branch or in the presence of a Spanish public notary. Remote onboarding is possible only for low-risk corporate clients with full documentary traceability; for the described High_Risk_Special_License category, physical interview and source-of-funds verification are mandatory in most Tier-1 Spanish commercial banks.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Legal person classified as a fiduciary administrator of an irrevocable offshore spendthrift trust without a visible Spanish regulatory license or clear supervisory classification.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bundle comprising: (i) certified certificate of incorporation and current registry filings from the Spanish Commercial Registry; (ii) statutory license or authorization issued by the competent Spanish supervisory authority for ISIC 6430 fiduciary activities, or a binding legal opinion confirming the applicable licensing exemption; (iii) notarized deed of incorporation and appointment of directors; (iv) corporate articles of association; (v) bank's internal KYC questionnaire completed with the exact contractual role of the SL; and (vi) a formal compliance map identifying the AML/CFT supervisory authority.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque beneficial ownership structure using a discretionary trust with no named beneficiaries, with the SL appearing only as trustee or protector.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A complete beneficial-ownership declaration under Spanish Law 10/2010 and Royal Decree 304/2014, including: the settled settlement deed or trust instrument, protector letter, settlor details, classes of beneficiaries, and written confirmation that the SL neither holds nor administers assets without an authenticated trust instrument; a Spanish central beneficial-ownership registry extract; an organizational chart of the trust structure; and an undertaking to update the UBO register within the statutory filing window.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident directors, ultimate beneficial owners, or settlers domiciled in jurisdictions characterized by deemed tax havens, high-risk countries, or non-cooperative territories.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Individual KYC package for each non-resident person, comprising: EU/Europol-compliant passport copy, notarized proof of residential address, apostilled police record certificate or equivalent, curriculum vitae or source-of-wealth narrative, professional background verification, tax residence certificate issued by the relevant foreign tax authority, and a written explanation of legitimate commercial purpose connecting the non-resident ownership to the Spanish entity's fiduciary activities.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound capital contributions or trust distributions from third-party jurisdictions without a clear transactional purpose, security-pricing basis, or settlement linkage.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A transaction-level dossier containing: executed contribution or trust settlement agreement; invoice or fee agreement for fiduciary administration services; bank reference from the remitting institution; SWIFT confirmation with full purpose code; underlying asset valuation report or independent appraisal; proof of payment of any applicable Spanish transfer tax; and an anti-money-laundering source-of-funds declaration prepared by the SL's compliance officer and signed by the board.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Absence of internal AML/KYC policies, absence of a Spanish compliance officer, or ineffective procedures for monitoring unusual trust-related transactions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: An AML/CFT manual adopted by the SL's board, naming a compliance officer with sufficient Spanish domicile and seniority; a risk-assessment questionnaire specific to the fiduciary and trust-administration business; a group-wide CDD and EDD policy; staff training certificates; a transaction monitoring and suspicious-transaction reporting protocol in accordance with Law 10/2010; and an external audit report confirming adequacy of internal controls.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital contributions from the settlor, protector, or third-party investors to the Spanish SL must be routed through the SWIFT network using wire transfer types MT103, MT202, or a direct TARGET2 credit transfer into the SL's EUR account. The credit message must include the beneficiary's IBAN, the Bank of Spain BIC code, a material-purpose reference clearly identifying the capital injection as equity or quasi-equity funding, and the relevant business justification. Where the transaction exceeds the Spanish foreign-investment declaration threshold, the SL must file the post-closure foreign-investment declaration with the Registro de Inversiones Exteriores immediately after execution. The inbound transfer should be preceded by a written share-subscription, capital-contribution, or loan agreement, matched against the bank's proof-of-funds checklist, and must pass sanctions and PEP screening before crediting.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound disbursements for fiduciary trust operations, trade payments, sub-trust distributions, professional fees, and treasury netting should be executed via SWIFT MT103 for single-customer credit transfers, MT202 for interbank/treasury cover payments, or SEPA Credit Transfer for EEA counterparties where no FX conversion is necessary. Commercial trade settlement may also be effected through documentary letters of credit opened or advised under ICC UCP 600 and SWIFT MT700/MT707 messages, with direct MT103 settlement by the issuing or confirming bank. All outbound EUR transfers from the Spanish SL to non-resident beneficiaries or business counterparties above the regulatory threshold must be reported to Banco de España in the applicable balance-of-payments statistical declaration and must contain clear settlement references, including underlying trust instrument references, invoices, or commercial contracts, to prevent AML query blocks.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Spot FX contracts for immediate settlement of trust assets or investment inflows, executed through any Spanish licensed credit institution or authorized investment firm.
Outright FX forward contracts (deliverable forwards) with tenors matched to the projected settlement flows of trust disbursements or inbound capital calls.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) where the underlying currency or settlement constraint renders a deliverable forward impossible or impractical, provided the transaction is executed under an ISDA 2002 Master Agreement with a qualifying credit institution and subject to EMIR collateral and reporting obligations.
FX swaps combining a spot and a forward leg to manage short-term cross-currency liquidity of multi-currency trust accounts.

Cross-currency swaps and long-term EUR-in/USD-out or EUR-out/USD-in hedging transactions under ISDA documentation, with appropriate credit support annexes and Bank of Spain/EMIR reporting where applicable.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Approval and filing of annual accounts
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Accounts must be approved within six months after financial year-end and filed within one month after approval.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines generally range from EUR 1,200 to EUR 60,000, with higher limits for larger companies. Registry closure may occur after one year of non-filing; continued closure may lead to ex officio dissolution, but Spain has no automatic annual-return strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Spanish Tax Agency (Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within the first 25 calendar days following the six-month period after the end of the tax year; for a calendar-year company, normally 1 to 25 July.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalties, interest and, where applicable, tax surcharges apply. Tax deficiencies may trigger additional assessment penalties and enforcement proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Legalization of accounting and corporate books
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Electronic legalization generally within four months after the financial year-end; for a calendar-year company, normally by 30 April.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or omitted legalization may impair evidentiary value, expose the company and directors to compliance liability, and contribute to registry-compliance issues. No standalone automatic strike-off applies.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Ultimate beneficial ownership statement and annual confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Mercantile Registry and Central Registry of Beneficial Ownership, as applicable
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Beneficial ownership information must remain accurate and current. Confirmation or updating is normally coordinated with annual accounts filing and must be made promptly after any ownership or control change.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Inaccurate or missing beneficial ownership information may cause registry refusal or closure, AML compliance measures, administrative sanctions and enhanced scrutiny by competent authorities.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Company members, followed by the Mercantile Registry with the annual accounts
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Audit must be completed before annual accounts approval and the audit report filed with the accounts within the statutory filing period.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to obtain a mandatory audit may prevent valid accounts filing, cause registry closure, expose directors to liability and trigger administrative penalties.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Regulated fiduciary or trust-services authorization renewal, if applicable
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Competent Spanish licensing or supervisory authority, determined by the precise regulated activity
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No uniform annual renewal deadline applies to all fiduciary activities; renewal follows the conditions of the specific authorization.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Operating without required authorization may result in activity cessation orders, administrative fines, AML sanctions, loss of authorization and potential criminal exposure for unauthorized regulated activity.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Independent audit is generally mandatory when a company exceeds at least two of these thresholds for two consecutive financial years: total assets above EUR 2.85 million, annual net turnover above EUR 5.7 million, or average employees above 50. Additional mandatory-audit rules apply to public-interest entities, certain regulated activities, companies receiving specified public subsidies, and other statutory cases.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Spanish General Accounting Plan (Plan General de Contabilidad) and applicable Spanish accounting legislation. IFRS is required for qualifying consolidated listed-group accounts and may apply in other permitted circumstances.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The company must identify and maintain accurate, adequate and current information on its ultimate beneficial owners. Ownership or control changes must be updated promptly, and the beneficial ownership declaration is generally confirmed or updated in connection with annual accounts filing. Share transfers must be recorded in the Register of Members and reflected in the beneficial ownership information where control changes.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro Registro de Socios)
Register of Contracts with the Sole Shareholder, if the company has a sole shareholder
Current beneficial ownership records and supporting identification documentation
Electronic legalized accounting and corporate books maintained in accordance with Mercantile Registry requirements

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: Approximately USD 350-1,500 per year, depending on registered-office, local representative, mail-handling and corporate-secretarial services.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Approximately USD 2,000-8,000 for a small Spanish SL subject to statutory audit; complex, regulated or cross-border fiduciary operations may cost more.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Newly incorporated Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada may benefit from a reduced 15% CIT rate for the first two tax years in which a positive taxable base arises; no sector-specific trust exemption applies; R&D and investment deductions may further reduce the effective rate.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 200 (Modelo 200), filed electronically through AEAT's online platform at www.agenciatributaria.es
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 25 calendar days after the six-month period following the tax year-end (e.g., 25 July for a fiscal year ending 31 December).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: NIF and corporate identification data of the SL
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the Spanish NIF of the SL; non-resident beneficiaries are not reported on this field.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable base after set-off of prior-year losses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report the corporate taxable base; foreign ownership does not affect the SL's own taxable base.
Compute at 25% (or 15% if newly created and eligible).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net tax liability after deductions and withholdings
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply applicable deductions; do not include non-resident beneficiary income in this line.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Result of the return: balance payable or refundable
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If previous quarterly prepayments exceed final liability, the excess is refunded; non-resident shareholder withholding is reported separately.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing without prior AEAT notice: 5% surcharge within first 3 months, 10% within 3-6 months, 15% within 6-12 months, 20% after 12 months, plus late-payment interest; negligent non-filing or under-reporting triggers a penalty of 50%-150% of the tax amount.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 202 (Modelo 202), filed electronically through AEAT portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Calendar-year entities: 1-20 April, 1-20 October, 1-20 December; for non-calendar year-end entities, within 1st-20th of the month following the close of each approved quarterly period.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the Spanish NIF; no foreign identifier is required.
Usually 31 December for a calendar-year entity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Prepayment amount based on prior-year tax
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident ownership does not alter the prepayment calculation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total amount to pay (importe a ingresar)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Wire to AEAT or pay by direct debit.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file or underpayment: surcharge from 5% to 20% of the correct prepayment plus late interest; if non-filing is detected by AEAT, a penalty of 50% of the amount not paid may apply.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 19% domestic Non-Resident Income Tax (IRNR); 0% under the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive for a qualifying EU corporate shareholder holding at least 5% for 12 months; treaty rates generally 5%-15%.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Beneficial owner must obtain a Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) from its home tax authority and deliver it to the Spanish SL before payment, together with a residence statement. If the payer withheld at 19%, a refund may be claimed by filing Modelo 210 within four years, attaching TRC and proof of entitlement.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Interest: 19% domestic IRNR; royalties: 24% domestic IRNR; EU Interest and Royalty Directive abolishes WHT on interest and royalties to associated EU companies; DTA rates usually range from 0% to 10%.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Net turnover (importe neto de la cifra de negocios) exceeding EUR 10 million in the immediately preceding year, or related-party transactions surpassing EUR 250,000 in a tax year; Local File and where applicable Master File must be prepared.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Spain applies general anti-abuse rules (LGT Article 15) and the substance-over-form doctrine; for fiduciary trust administration, the SL must maintain real presence, staff, minutes, trust records, and economic capacity to exercise independent discretion. Any arrangement that is an artificial shell designed to protect assets from creditors may be recharacterised as a sham and taxed to the true owner.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Intentionally falsifying accounts or omitting offshore trust income from the SL's Spanish tax return, causing tax loss exceeding EUR 120,000 per year.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal conviction under Criminal Code Article 305: imprisonment 1-5 years, fine of 2 to 6 times the defrauded amount, and withdrawal of benefits/subsidies; plus AEAT administrative penalty of 50%-150% of the tax loss and late interest.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who designed the scheme are jointly and severally liable for unpaid tax and penalties; criminal conviction may impose travel bans, surrender of passports, disqualification from directorships, and civil restitution.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the SL as a one-person corporate trustee with no employees, no records, and no independent discretion, solely as a protective vessel for the settlor's assets from Spanish creditors or tax authorities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: AEAT may disregard the entity under abuse-of-law doctrine and tax the assets/income in the hands of the settlor; penalty of 100%-150% of the resulting tax may be imposed; civil courts may annul the trust deed or order liquidation of the SL.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be held personally responsible for corporate tax debts if they approved the sham transaction; a judge may impose disqualification from managing companies for up to 10 years, and criminal asset-stripping (alzamiento de bienes) liability carries imprisonment of 1-4 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the discretionary asset protection trust without the required statutory license or undertaking trust administration by an unlicensed SL; failing to perform CDD on settlors and beneficiaries; failing to submit suspicious transaction reports on high-risk non-resident transfers.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Law 10/2010: minor infringement fines up to EUR 60,000; serious violations up to EUR 1,000,000 or 5% of annual turnover; very serious up to EUR 5,000,000 or 10% of turnover; license revocation and public naming in the Official Gazette.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors knowingly involved in money laundering via trust asset shielding may face criminal money-laundering charges under Article 301 of the Criminal Code: imprisonment 6 months to 6 years, fines, forfeiture of assets, and potential travel restrictions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Charging artificially high fees to related-party trust beneficiaries or settlor-controlled companies for administrative services without arm's length comparability, and failing to prepare mandatory Local/Master Files despite exceeding the EUR 10 million threshold.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: AEAT may adjust taxable income using TNMM or CUP, impose late interest, and apply administrative penalty of 50%-150% of the deficient tax; failure to keep documentation triggers a fixed penalty and potential presumption of non-compliance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Where the pricing manipulation is deliberate, directors are jointly and severally liable for the tax debt and penalties; if the adjusted income exceeds the criminal threshold, the directors may additionally face tax-fraud charges.
